note: NOT BANKED. Fresh 12 — NOT repaired cr-v4 items. cr-v4 came in at +22.2, inside the pre-registration's 20-30 inconclusive band at n=12. This slice exists to leave that band with a clear number in either direction. The brief's load-bearing property is UNCHANGED and not under test: vary the stimulus, generate distractors as replies to near-miss lines.
oneNewRule: BAN the incredulous restatement with an intensifier — 'X at all?', 'outright', 'all week', 'in one go', 'Nothing ...?' — from EVERY option. Solver 2 named it unprompted on cr-v4: it appeared only in distractors and was a near-perfect negative marker. Banned outright rather than balanced, because putting it in keys at the same rate would make its ABSENCE the marker instead. This is a brief-level rule, not a repair of the attacked items, so it is not tuning against the attack.
secondDiscipline: Every option carries the two-move shape the solvers keep describing — echo the premise, then commit to an action or ask a narrow follow-up. In cr-v4 that was already true, which is why the heuristic failed them. Held here deliberately.
